[b]A Decree Re-Establishing Relations with the Second Republic of Flousech[/b]

[b]Whereas[/b] these wicked times have seen the mending of relationship with that nation once estranged, by the common decree of the wisdom of freedom. 

[b]Whereas[/b] there exists a present need and dual desire for cooperation and aid between the two states of Thýven and Flousech, the patriarchal government of Thýven hereby declares:

[list]1. A State of Peace shall exist between Thýven and Flousech
2. Trade shall immediately be re-established with the details of such being convened at a formal meeting between representatives of the government
3. Thýven shall permit the training and funding of the armed forces of Flousech through the procurement of bonds and loans of monetary and technical value.
4. The government of Thýven shall re-establish embassy and permit the establishment of embassy by the Second Republic.
5. The National Gold Reserve shall be granted limited annual access to the Second Republic and its government, amounting to an annual transaction amounting to 1.4% of gold therein reciprocated by trade from the Second Republic.
[/list]
 
The provisions of this decree shall come into force within a week of its passing [i]29 July 2026[/i]
---------
[nation]United Hydronia[/nation]
[nation]Skullsbrough[/nation]
[nation]Tallisland[/nation]

[list][list] [i]" Isdentai Zeten-ati Inaka, if you have chosen by happenstance or by intent to land on three-seven-six hertz, welcome to the Zetenvian National Broadcast, here we report on all matters relating to the Third Federal Republic of Ascoiya, We apologize for our sudden and abrupt end on the 17th, fear not we have managed to get our tower restored and slightly upgraded. now let us get onto the weather and then the news. " Since then there has been many calls from both the mainland provinces and the coastal province citizens to outlaw such corporate influence, as of this time there is no current or offical statement from the Representative Council, yet we are getting rumors here within the ZAC studio that there maybe some changes soon. "

" Beyond that the Minister of Economy Asertl-Zeten Ulatero has officially declared that foreigners arriving under work matters are allowed to extend their limited residency up to the termination of their employment, such statement has been backed by the Department of Foreign-Citizen Affairs as a result now requiring all foreign workers to file a CT-32 Form to allot themselves a "Near-Permanent Residency status, as a result some Citizens have begun to declare such changes as Non-Zetenvian others calling for a refined and streamlined allowance of what some are calling "Pristine-Foreign workers" into the country, we will try our best to report of such matters yet things are becoming a bit shaky as of currently" [/i] [/list][/list]

[b]July 23, 2026: Politicisation[/b]
It had been decades since the last political party sat formally in the Gøsfodde, replaced instead by topical interest groups known as the Fondenfoddel. Political parties had been banned in 1992 a decade after the fall of the dictatorship of the Rysse dynasty, however, as it became evident that the Fondendoddel structure had failed to maintain the Elseyr-Vespurian union, the orthodox government moved to formally permit the formation of political fronts within the Gøsfodde. 

Thus on July 23rd a decree went out from the patriarchate announcing a lifting of the ban on political parties, citing the second core pillar of the state, freedom. 
-=--=-=-=-=-=

[b]The Flight[/b]

It had barely been an hour since the decree was signed that Alfred Erjksson, the prelate for international affairs of the Executive Patriarchal Office of Thýven boarded a government plane for Flousech, the moment was momentous for Thýven, it represented an apex in the definition of its new foreign policy titled "Stability and Prosperity above all", it was a wide reaching idea that meant bridging ideological lines in order to promote Thýven as a mission of orthodoxy and peace to the world. With Alfred was Elbert Mürre, the vice chairman of the Bank of Tharkønn, who had come along to supervise the unfreezing and reclaiming of Thýven's assets in Flousech. The plane turned towards Velvetel, and the pilot announced that they had begun to descend, and much to Alfred's horror he realised no formal communique had been sent to the government of Flousech that they were coming.
